goal: Prevents crashes and unexpected behaviors caused by negating startup options like limits and paths
Ensures node startup fails safely when nonsensical negated configuration options are passed
agreement: Strong support with all reviewer suggestions addressed
Concept approval noting that surprising option negations were previously documented (l0rinc)
Concept approval urging that negation should mean false, zero, or an error (ryanofsky)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it prevents startup limits from triggering assertion crashes in TxGraph
Stops configurations like -limitclustersize=0 from causing every transaction to fail

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it prevents hazardous side effects across startup options that evaluated negations to zero
Stops unexpected network connections, writing blocks to the working directory, or running binary '0'
